scenes.summary: A Tianshi tells you how the Migratory Fowl Rod has been pointing in the same direction, though he fails to find any sign of malfunction. Perlica deduces that Wei Xidong might be using the instrument to call for help.

lines.text: No Blight contaminants here either...
No, the method is working. We even released more fowls with flight recorders.
He said he's going to calibrate the Xiranflow Cloudseeder one last time, and collect the final set of data...
He also mentioned about wanting to see the "traces of the designer".
If the Rod is working properly, perhaps Tianshi Wei lost connection signals, and resorted to using unconventional means to contact us.
Let's go find him, then! We got someone to save!
We're inversely mapping polluted zones with fowlbeast flight paths. Did the method fail?
The Migratory Fowl Rod isn't malfunctioning either, but it's pointing at a place with no fowls flying overhead.

options: Did Tianshi Wei tell you his plans?

scenes.summary: You find Wei Xidong. He rushed to this place on his own to collect a set of key data, only to find himself trapped by Aggeloi. Desperate, he threw stones to scare a flock of fowls and trigger the Migratory Fowl Rod's response. You are glad he is alright. Data collection is also successful.

lines.text: You actually knew it was my SOS signal! I've been throwing pebbles at flocks of fowls to send them flying...
Are you hurt?
I'm actually fine. Just sprained my ankle while dodging the Aggeloi, and broke my handyterm during the fall...
Yeah, but I noticed strange flight paths of several fowls... This key data is very transient and easily missed. I forgot to call Miss Overflow while rushing here...
You should call the Yinglungs. They're looking for you.
Ah, I apologize for causing all this trouble...
I did! I was wrapping up when the buggerloids busted into the scene. During my escape, I slipped and rolled down the slope... Thank goodness the data is alright!
Let's go. We'll escort you back to the Xiranflow Cloudseeder.

options: Please refrain from such adventures next time.
Did you get your key data?

scenes.summary: Wei Xidong analyzes the gathered data and decides to optimize the energy injector components. The upgrade requires some Pyrrolite Parts, so he asks you for assistance.

lines.text: No lag in response ... perfect. We can now install an energy injector component and activate the Xiranflow Cloudseeder.
But ... yeah ... from the data I just gathered ... I still need to make this absolutely risk-free...
Endmin, I'm just missing some Pyrrolite Parts. I still need to optimize certain pieces of the hardware.
Yeah. Very, very crucial... We must be meticulous.
Pyrrolite Parts, right? We'll AIC it, like, NOW!

options: Your data gathering run is actually useful.
The last step is also the most crucial.

scenes.summary: Wei Xidong is extremely emotional as he witnesses the activation of the Xiranflow Cloudseeder. This facility, along with other construction projects in Wuling, is only made possible through generations of perseverance. He decides to carry on the torch and continue to commit himself to learning and science.

lines.text: Endmin, I really thank you for all the support you gave me.
The successful construction of the Xiranflow Cloudseeder would be impossible without you.
Remember what I said about those old comments? My Instructor wrote them. She was amongst those who constructed Yinglung Pass.
Before passing away, she told me about how someone gave her an idea, how Xiranite might be useful to restore the air and the land...
She committed to that idea throughout her entire life ... and then passed it on to me.
But like those before me, I shall accept this task. I shall help build Yinglung Pass and commit myself to the field of environmental remediation!
Heheh. I might come up with tech that'd be useful in other places, or even change the future of Talos-II...
When the need arises, I wonder if I can get a letter of recommendation from the Endmin for my paper?
LOOK! It's activating!
Complete elimination of Blight contamination will take a really long time. The expansion project is just starting too...

I found out that designs for the Xiranflow Cloudseeder were drafted by several senior Tianshi. The same combination of water, greenery, and fowls is used everywhere ... from the Science Station to Wuling City.
Everyone's work contributed, like trickles merging into rivers, like water dripping through stone after decades if not centuries of work.

scenes.summary: The Xiranflow Cloudseeder is successfully activated. Wei Xidong invites you to a scenic vantage point to witness the results.

lines.text: WE DID IT!
We couldn't have done it without you. Xiranflow Cloudseeder — the ultimate pollution-destroyer of Yinglung Pass, is finally OPERATIONAL!
We can use Xiranite rain to improve Yinglung Pass ecology, and start expanding this installation...
Endmin, I wonder if I can formally invite you to a scenic vantage point, and witness the facility's formal activation.
What a generous load! This is definitely more than enough to get everything covered!
